texts.text:
The room stood when the Dohkar stood. I did not, and that was the first thing anyone noticed about me that day.

Out of the assembly came three of Seren's people, and they did not look at me at all. They looked at the Dohkar, which was worse.

SEREN'S ELDEST COUSIN: “We ask remedy for what the rite cost her. Enter it, Dohkar, and enter it before your inquiry.”

Julian set The Answer's case down on the table and closed it, and did not say the thing he had been building toward for an hour.

THE PRESIDING DOHKAR: “It is entered. The complaint stands apart from my ruling on her conduct.”

I realize that old tarot deck is still in my hand. Reassuringly solid. Present. One of the heavy gold cards slips out — “Petition Fate” is inscribed in it.
